rationale: No suitable optimization is supported. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (changing fail-fast from false to true) would cancel remaining matrix jobs after a failure, but the workflow builds two independent configurations (Debug and Release) and canceling one would reduce intended build coverage; required_checks are not verified, so the contraindication that every matrix outcome may be required cannot be ruled out. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be safely applied because representative successful-duration history is unclear (ci_history timestamps are inconsistent, with some runs appearing to span many hours), so a safe timeout bound cannot be determined without risking false failures on valid slow runs. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE could cache the DirectX SDK download, but the evidence is observational with modest benefit and no clear prerequisite verification supports it for this workflow. Other patterns (Bazel parallelism/incremental caching, scheduled-run suppression, test selection/prioritization, change filtering) do not fit this CMake matrix build workflow.
